name: Manual Multi-Class Phenotyping
description:
You are a researcher preparing a ground-truth dataset for a cell classification model. Using Fiji (ImageJ), manually classify objects in the 'Blobs (25K)' sample image into two categories: 'Round' and 'Elongated'.

1. Open the 'Blobs (25K)' sample image (File > Open Samples > Blobs).
2. Select the Multi-point Tool.
3. Configure the tool to use distinct counters for different classes (e.g., double-click the tool icon to set specific counters/types).
4. Mark at least 5 'Round' objects (high circularity) using one counter type.
5. Mark at least 5 'Elongated' objects (stretched/deformed) using a DIFFERENT counter type.
6. Measure/Export the list of points to a CSV file named 'manual_counts.csv' in '~/ImageJ_Data/results/'.

The output CSV must contain columns for coordinates (X, Y) and the Counter/Type/Slice information to distinguish the two classes.
